title: The use of urological preventive examinations - a qualitative analysis of patients' participation decisions
summary:
The aim of the project is to further discuss the use of urological early detection examinations. Above all, reasons for and against using this examination should be examined. The debate about PSA screening will also be further explored in expert interviews. 
The study is carried out as a cross-sectional survey using interviews conducted by two general practitioners, urologists and patients over 45 years old.
conditions: The use of urological screening examinations

interventions.name: Guided Interviews with 2 male Patients > 45 years
Guided Interviews with 2 male family doctors

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Specialists: completed specialist training, German language test, established practice
Men: Presence of prostate
Exclusion criteria:
Men: Missing prostate, female
Specialists: Lack of specialist German language test or lack of specialist training, only clinical activities
